_readme.purpose: In-repo source of truth for each Spanish DO/DOP/DOCa's official municipality list, resolved to INE mun_codes and dissolved into the DO outline (municipality-union model — Spain has no national parcel/DO polygon layer, so this mirrors the Champagne/Alsace commune-union path).
_readme.how_geometry_is_built: run-spain-dos.mjs resolves each entry's municipalities against the georef-spain-municipio cache (fetch-spain-municipios.mjs) via spain-lib.mjs, dissolves the whole-municipality polygons, stages a DRAFT boundary with IGN_CNIG_SPAIN provenance, runs the auto-promote guards, and (if they all pass) promotes it to current-VALIDATED / the place to VERIFIED. There is no human review gate (owner decision) — the guards are the only safety net.
_readme.provenance_rule: MEMBERSHIP MUST COME FROM THE OFFICIAL BOE PLIEGO DE CONDICIONES, NOT FROM RECALL. Every entry records provenance.source (the BOE reference / URL and retrieval date). The resolver fails closed on any municipality that does not map to exactly one INE code in the right province, and on any expected_count mismatch — but it CANNOT detect a plausible-but-incomplete list, which is why the source must be authoritative.

status_values.pending: Scaffolded but NOT yet sourced from a pliego — municipios is empty. run-spain-dos.mjs SKIPS these. This is the current state of every entry: the build session had no web access to fetch pliegos, so no list was transcribed from memory.
status_values.ready: municipios sourced from the cited pliego and filled in. run-spain-dos.mjs will stage + guard + promote it.

entry_shape.comunidad_key: the 2nd key segment; also the tile shard key
entry_shape.comunidad: display name of the autonomous community (SUBREGION node)
entry_shape.appellation_level: regional | subregional | communal (drives tier/zoom + the area-band guard)
entry_shape.parent_key: optional — a parent DO whose outline must contain this one (sub-zone containment guard)
entry_shape.provinces: [INE prov_code or prov_name] — scopes name resolution so duplicate town names across provinces disambiguate
entry_shape.expected_count: number of municipalities in the pliego — the resolver asserts it resolved exactly this many
entry_shape.municipios: [{ code: '<INE 5-digit>', name: '<official/co-official name for review>' } | { name: '<name>' }]. Code-first is REQUIRED for bilingual comunidades (Galicia/Cataluna/Valencia/Pais Vasco) where the georef name is the co-official form; name-only is fine for Castilian-only comunidades.
entry_shape.grapes: optional [variety names] for the knowledge migration
entry_shape.scoring_reference: optional exact appellation name for the scoring-reference link
entry_shape.provenance: { source: 'BOE-A-YYYY-NNNNN / MAPA pliego', url, retrieved: 'YYYY-MM-DD', note }

_readme.resume: Once a pliego list is available for an entry: set municipios (+ expected_count + provenance) and status:'ready', then `node scripts/wine-map-sources/run-spain-dos.mjs --dry` (verifies resolve+dissolve+guards, rolls back) and finally without --dry to stage+promote. The run is resumable: it skips any DO that already has a current-VALIDATED boundary.

denominations.provinces_note: La Rioja (26) + Alava/Araba (01, Rioja Alavesa) + Navarra (31). Trans-comunidad DOCa: keyed under la-rioja with the Alava/Navarra municipalities included in the dissolve.

provenance.source: Pliego de condiciones DOP «Priorat» (DOQ/DOCa), Ministerio de Agricultura, Pesca y Alimentación
provenance.note: Section 4.1 'Zona de producción de la uva'. 10 municipios (Tarragona). 'Su agregado Escaladei' is part of La Morera de Montsant; the partial inclusion 'la parte norte del municipio de Falset' is taken whole (documented whole-municipality over-approximation).

provenance.note: PENDING.

provenance.source: Pliego de condiciones DOP «Rueda» (PDO-ES-A0889), Ministerio de Agricultura, Pesca y Alimentación
provenance.note: Whole-municipality union of the pliego zona de producción. 68 of 74 listed entries map to INE municipios; excluded as pedanías/sub-entities covered by a listed parent, or not a current INE municipio: Gomeznarro, Rodilana (Medina del Campo), Bernuy de Coca (Santiuste de San Juan Bautista), Moraleja de Coca, Montuenga, Torrecilla del Valle. Cadastral-polygon partial inclusions (Órbita, Palacios de Goda, Coca) taken whole (documented over-approximation).

provenance.source: Pliego de condiciones DOP «Toro» (PDO-ES-A0886), Ministerio de Agricultura, Pesca y Alimentación
provenance.note: Whole-municipality union of the pliego zona de producción. Zamora (12) + Valladolid: San Román de Hornija, Villafranca de Duero, and Pedrosa del Rey (the pliego includes only its Villaester de Arriba/Abajo pagos; taken whole — documented over-approximation).

provenance.source: BOE/DOG pliego DOP Rías Baixas
provenance.note: PENDING — bilingual (Galician): use code-first.

provenance.source: Pliego de condiciones DOP «Cigales», Ministerio de Agricultura, Pesca y Alimentación
provenance.note: Whole-municipality union. 11 Valladolid municipios (incl. Corcos = pliego 'Corcos del Valle', and Valoria la Buena) + Dueñas (Palencia). The 'El Berrocal' pago, which the pliego notes lies within the término municipal of the city of Valladolid, is EXCLUDED — including the whole Valladolid city municipality for one pago would grossly over-represent the DO.

provenance.source: Pliego de condiciones DOP «Arribes» (PDO-ES-A0614), Ministerio de Agricultura, Pesca y Alimentación
provenance.note: Whole-municipality union of the pliego zona de producción. 18 Salamanca + 14 Zamora INE municipios. Monumenta (a real Zamora member) is excluded — it has no polygon in the georef-spain-municipio cache, so no geometry to dissolve. Pliego pedanías that are not separate INE municipios also excluded (Corporario, Valdenoguera; Abelón, Badilla, Carbajosa de Alba, Castro de Alcañices, Cibanal, Cozcurrita, Formariz, Fornillos de Fermoselle, Mámoles, Pinilla de Fermoselle, Salto de Castro, Santa Eulalia — sub-entities of listed parents). Almaraz de Duero and Muelas del Pan (partial cadastral-polygon inclusions) taken whole.

provenance.source: Pliego de condiciones DOP «Somontano», Ministerio de Agricultura, Pesca y Alimentación
provenance.note: Whole-municipality union of the 43 Huesca términos municipales listed in the pliego (área geográfica).

provenance.source: Pliego de condiciones DOP «Jumilla», Ministerio de Agricultura, Pesca y Alimentación
provenance.note: Trans-comunidad DOP keyed under Murcia (town of Jumilla, prov 30); 6 of 7 municipios are in Albacete / Castilla-La Mancha (prov 02): Fuente-Álamo, Albatana, Ontur, Hellín, Tobarra, Montealegre del Castillo. Whole-municipality union.

provenance.source: Pliego de condiciones DOP «Jerez-Xérès-Sherry», §D.1 Zona Delimitada (Junta de Andalucía / MAPA)
provenance.note: Whole-municipality union of the 10 términos municipales of the Marco de Jerez (9 in Cádiz + Lebrija in Sevilla). Same delimited zone underlies DOP Manzanilla-Sanlúcar de Barrameda (not added here).

provenance.source: Pliego de condiciones DOP «Ribeiro» (Ourense), Ministerio de Agricultura, Pesca y Alimentación
provenance.note: Whole-municipality union. 9 whole ayuntamientos + 4 municipios included whole though the pliego delimits them by parroquia/lugar (O Carballiño, Boborás, Toén, San Amaro). Ourense EXCLUDED: only the lugares of Santa Cruz de Arrabaldo/Untes belong, so including the whole city would grossly over-represent. Galician DOs are parroquia-delimited; this is a coarser whole-municipality over-approximation.

provenance.source: Pliego de condiciones DOP «Montsant» (Tarragona), Ministerio de Agricultura, Pesca y Alimentación
provenance.note: Whole-municipality union of the 12 whole términos municipales + Falset (pliego includes Falset by polígono; taken whole). The Montsant DO rings the Priorat DOQ.
